crossRefs.note: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.
“Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.
I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
He said to me, “See you don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with…
Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for…

translations.web: “Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”
translations.bsb: “Behold, I am coming soon. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book.”
translations.kjv: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
translations.asv: And behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he that keepeth the words of the prophecy of this book.
